summary: Russian forces conducted a fourth consecutive day of mass Geran-5 rocket and reactive UAV strikes across western and central Ukraine, hitting Ivano-Frankivsk, Lviv, Ternopil, Rivne, and targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, and Khmelnytskyi regions. Ukrainian strikes reportedly hit Russian missile production facilities in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, including the Barmin NII, ICBM liquidation center, and Redkinsky plant producing fuel for Kh-55/101 cruise missiles. Russian "North" grouping claimed capture of Kiyanitsa village in Sumy region while heavy fighting continues along the eastern front in Kupyansk, Krasnolymansk, and Druzhkivka directions.
key_points: Geran-5 rockets struck Dubno (Rivne), Ternopil, Ivano-Frankivsk, and Lviv, with reactive UAVs targeting Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, and Khmelnytskyi regions during a fourth consecutive day of mass attacks. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76513, @mon1tor_ua/76512, @mon1tor_ua/76522, @mon1tor_ua/76521, @kpszsu/84637, @kpszsu/84666, @kpszsu/84660)
Seven civilians injured in Rivne region including four children, one 13-year-old boy in serious condition, from Russian attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/84579)

Ukrainian strikes targeted Russian missile infrastructure in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions: Barmin NII start complexes, ICBM liquidation center, and Redkinsky plant producing Kh-55/101 fuel components. (Source: @UkraineNow/84565)
Russian "North" grouping reportedly seized Kiyanitsa village in Sumy region, with assault units advancing 300 meters in the area. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33852, @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
Russian MoD claimed a strike on a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Odesa port. (Source: @tass_agency/399635)
Kyiv suffered widespread power outages, metro shutdown, and water supply disruptions across five districts after an energy facility strike on October 8. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
South Korea recalled its ambassador to Ukraine amid bilateral tensions. (Source: @tass_agency/399628)

Zelensky condemned US license allowing Russian diesel exports, calling it an investment in war; Trump and Putin discussed diesel supplies in a phone call. (Source: @UkraineNow/84581, @UkraineNow/84582, @eRadarrua/121598)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces intensified a fourth consecutive day of mass Geran-5 rocket and reactive UAV strikes across western and central Ukraine, hitting Ivano-Frankivsk, Lviv, Ternopil, and Rivne while reactive UAVs targeted Kyiv, Vinnytsia, Zhytomyr, and Khmelnytskyi regions. Ukrainian forces reportedly struck key Russian missile production facilities in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, including the Barmin NII start complexes, an ICBM liquidation center, and the Redkinsky plant manufacturing fuel components for Kh-55/101 cruise missiles. On the ground, Russian "North" grouping claimed capture of Kiyanitsa village in Sumy region with a 300-meter advance, while heavy fighting persists along the eastern front in Kupyansk, Krasnolymansk, and Druzhkivka directions.

points: Ukrainian forces conducted strikes on Russian missile production infrastructure in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver regions, targeting the Barmin NII start complexes, an ICBM liquidation center, and the Redkinsky plant producing fuel components for Kh-55 and Kh-101 cruise missiles. (Source: @UkraineNow/84565)

Ukrainian air defense engaged multiple Geran-5 rockets and reactive UAVs across western and central regions, with air raid alerts activated in Kyiv at 05:53 and cleared at 04:09 on October 10, 2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/121614, @eRadarrua/121613, @kpszsu/84637, @kpszsu/84666, @kpszsu/84660)

Civilian casualties mounted from Russian attacks: seven injured in Rivne region including four children (one 13-year-old in serious condition), one killed and seven injured in Zaporizhzhia, three injured in Kyiv region, and one killed in Ivano-Frankivsk. (Source: @UkraineNow/84579, @UkraineNow/84559)

Critical infrastructure damage reported: widespread power outages in Kyiv after October 8 energy facility strike, metro shutdown, water supply disruptions in five districts (Sviatoshynskyi, Solomianskyi, Shevchenkivskyi, Holosiivskyi, Pecherskyi), and damage to energy transmission facilities nationwide. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847, @UkraineNow/84566)

President Zelensky condemned the US temporary license allowing Russian diesel exports to global markets, calling it an "investment in war" and demanding real de-escalation in a mirrored format. (Source: @UkraineNow/84582)

Ukrainian journalist Mykhailo Tkach, investigating former Prosecutor General Kravchenko, was detained in Vienna during an editorial assignment; Ukrainian embassy requested clarification from Austrian authorities. (Source: @UkraineNow/84560, @ukr_leaks_eng/33863)

Russian forces launched a massive fourth-day wave of Geran-5 rockets and reactive UAVs: 3 Geran-5 from Kyiv region to Zhytomyr (Korosten district), 2 reactive Shaheds circling on Kirovohrad-Dnipropetrovsk border, 2 Geran-5 from Khmelnytskyi to Ternopil (Chortkiv district), 1 from Vinnytsia to Khmelnytskyi (Kamianets-Podilskyi district), 1 from Khmelnytskyi to Rivne (Rivne district), 1 from Chernihiv to Kyiv (Vyshhorod district), 1 from Bryansk region to Chernihiv (Chernihiv district). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76509)

Geran-5 rockets struck Dubno (Rivne), Ternopil, Ivano-Frankivsk (two impacts reported), and Lviv (one impact confirmed), with reactive UAVs detected heading toward Volyn, Lviv, Poltava, and northern Vinnytsia regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76513, @mon1tor_ua/76512, @mon1tor_ua/76522, @mon1tor_ua/76521, @kpszsu/84668, @kpszsu/84685, @kpszsu/84686, @kpszsu/84689)

Russian "North" grouping claimed capture of Kiyanitsa village in Sumy region and a 300-meter advance by assault units in the area, with heavy fighting continuing north of Sumy and near Koryenka in Shostka district. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33852, @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Russian aviation, artillery, and UAV units struck areas of Sumy, Boyaro-Lezhachi, Stetskovka, Osoevka, and Turya in Sumy direction; strikes also reported on UAV assembly/storage facilities near Kovchin (Chernihiv region), positions of 105th Border Guard Detachment and 143rd Mechanized Brigade near Sutky and Semenivka, and command post of 18th Army Corps near Bahmachi. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
Russian MoD claimed a strike on a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo to Odesa port. (Source: @tass_agency/399635)

Domestic incidents in Russia: drone attack in Moscow region (Podolsk district) killed a 57-year-old man; Belgorod region strikes on civilian transport and settlements caused one death in Grayvoron, three injured, and multiple FPV drone attacks on vehicles; Kursk region drone attack killed a 53-year-old man in Ilek village. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In Kupyansk direction, Russian units continue offensive operations on eastern and northern approaches to Kupyansk, with clashes for positions and communication lines along the Oskil River. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
In Krasnolymansk direction, fighting continues for forest areas and settlements on the approaches to Krasny Lyman. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
In Druzhkivka direction, Russian units continue offensive operations with fighting reported on the approaches to the agglomeration and in the area of Dobropillya. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
In Zaporizhzhia direction, the "Skhid" Task Force reports continuation of offensives in several areas. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In Kharkiv direction, fighting continues in Liptsy, Volchansk, and Velikiy Burluk areas; "Pivnich" Task Force reported advance of assault units near Tokarevka and continued fighting with encircled AFU units in northeast Kharkiv region. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

Russian aviation, artillery, and UAV strikes hit Sumy, Boyaro-Lezhachi, Stetskovka, Osoevka, and Turya in Sumy direction. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)

In Chernihiv region, Russian strikes targeted UAV assembly and storage facilities near Kovchin, positions of 105th Border Guard Detachment and 143rd Mechanized Brigade near Sutky and Semenivka, and a command post of the 18th Army Corps near Bahmachi. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33847)
Geran-5 rocket launched from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv (Chernihiv district); reactive UAVs detected north of Dnipro heading to Poltava region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76509, @kpszsu/84685)

sections.threat_assessment: The sustained fourth-day mass drone and missile campaign against western and central Ukraine indicates a deliberate Russian strategy to overwhelm air defenses and degrade energy infrastructure ahead of winter. The simultaneous Ukrainian strikes on Russian missile production facilities in Nizhny Novgorod and Tver represent a significant escalation in targeting strategic military-industrial capacity, potentially disrupting Kh-55/101 cruise missile production. The claimed capture of Kiyanitsa in Sumy region, if confirmed, would mark a tangible Russian ground advance in the north, complementing ongoing offensives in Kupyansk, Krasnolymansk, and Druzhkivka directions.
